issues.description: Default pipeline points at data/stories, but the story dataset is not present, so a fresh documented run fails.
generate-stories requires an existing stories manifest before generation, preventing bootstrap from an empty data directory.
Model loading passes dtype to from_pretrained despite pyproject allowing older transformers versions that expect torch_dtype.
Saved vectors are loaded without checking manifest compatibility with the current config, model, scale, or expected shapes.
Validation trusts previously saved vector artifacts blindly and can silently evaluate stale or mismatched extraction outputs.
Steering trusts manifest layer and norm metadata without validating it against the loaded model or vector array dimensions.
all_token_activations stacks every hidden state for every token into memory, which can easily OOM for the configured model.
Story generation has no HTTP timeout, retry, status handling, or atomic write behavior, so failures can hang or leave partial datasets.
Story loading ignores manifest contents and does not validate dataset completeness before reading individual files.
PCA component selection divides by total variance without a zero-variance guard, producing NaNs on degenerate inputs.
Bradley-Terry fitting uses fixed-step gradient descent without convergence failure handling or numeric overflow guards.
Ignored generated artifacts are present in the workspace, including emovec.egg-info and 14MB of outputs.
